name: anti-ai-slop-writing
description: Natural, specific writing in English, Russian, and Ukrainian without stock AI mannerisms.

interface.shortDescription: Make prose specific, natural, and true to the author's voice.
interface.longDescription: Writes and revises audience-facing prose in English, Russian, or Ukrainian while preserving facts, intent, and the author's distinctive voice.
interface.defaultPrompt: Rewrite this text so it sounds natural and specific while preserving every fact and the author's voice.
